t: Made from polyurethane. Extremely light and robust, with a density comparable to traditional timber but much easier to fit. The flexibility to follow contours of uneven walls and ease of trimming with a knife or fine saw, means a professional look with minimal filling and no splitting. No primer or undercoat is required and a classy finish is easily achieved with water-based emulsion and gloss paints. Ease of installation and superior finish means this product is worth the premium, against either traditional wood or plaster products.
